entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Guess we might as well close up[n]for the night.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, once you're done washing that,[n]you can go ahead and call it a—

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Welcome.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Um...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yoshizawa?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Have a seat.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: She's here to see you, right? Don't[n]worry about finishing up—I'll take[n]care of it later.
entries.uk: Вона ж до тебе прийшла, так? Не[n]переймайся, що не доробив, — я потім[n]усе зроблю.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Sorry for coming over so late...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: And thank you for the coffee.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: It's delicious.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Would you mind if I... got something[n]off my chest?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Thank you.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: So, to tell the truth... I saw you all go[n]into the nurse's office today...
entries.uk: Чесно кажучи... Я бачила, як ви всі[n]сьогодні зайшли в медпункт...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: And, um... I sort of eavesdropped on[n]your conversation.
entries.uk: І, ем... Я трохи підслухала вашу[n]розмову.

entries.en: About Maruki?
About the actualization?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: You've all found the paths you want to[n]take and are following them with such[n]confidence...
entries.uk: Ви всі знайшли шлях, яким хочете йти,[n]і йдете ним так упевнено...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Whereas I'm simply...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: ...Like Dr. Maruki said before, I ran[n]from the truth.
entries.uk: ...Як і казав доктор Марукі, я втекла[n]від правди.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I couldn't handle the fact that Kasumi[n]died because of my actions.
entries.uk: Я не могла змиритися з тим, що Касумі[n]загинула через мене.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: My memories are still a bit hazy, but[n]even when I remembered that I'm really[n]Sumire, I didn't want to accept it...
entries.uk: Спогади досі трохи туманні, але навіть[n]коли я згадала, що насправді я Суміре,[n]я не хотіла цього визнавати...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I was still running from reality, where[n]Kasumi is gone... Where I had to live[n]for Kasumi instead of as her.
entries.uk: Я й далі тікала від реальності, де[n]Касумі немає... Де я маю жити заради[n]Касумі, а не як вона.

entries.en: Do you still want to run?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: No...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But, still...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Like I said earlier, I realized something[n]when I saw you all striving to push[n]onward...
entries.uk: Як я вже казала, я дещо зрозуміла,[n]коли побачила, як ви всі прагнете[n]іти вперед...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I can't keep running like this.
entries.uk: Я не можу й далі отак тікати.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But, now that Kasumi's gone, I have[n]no idea what to do with myself...
entries.uk: Але тепер, коли Касумі немає, я геть[n]не знаю, що з собою робити...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: [fName]-senpai... what should I do?
I know you'll choose well.
entries.uk: Я знаю, ти зробиш добрий вибір.

entries.en: You have to decide, not me.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: ...You can be awfully firm sometimes,[n][fName]-senpai...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But you're absolutely correct.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I must thank you for allowing me[n]to unload all of this onto you.
entries.uk: Дякую, що дозволив мені вилити[n]на тебе все це.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I'm still not completely sure what[n]I should do, but... I plan to think[n]more on it.
entries.uk: Я ще не зовсім певна, що мені робити,[n]але... Я ще подумаю над цим.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I've got to figure out what to do[n]with my life now.
entries.uk: Тепер я маю вирішити, що робити[n]зі своїм життям.
